shape: Dense 3-portal hub with potted-plant style obstacles (S+E+W gates)
description: Large three-portal arena divided into a west clique, a center-south clique near the south entry, an east arm with side detours, and a south-bay pocket near the SE. Each gate has its own entry hub; the west_inner is the highest-degree anchor and pivots between west clique + center routes. Same primitive family as paru-A td1 (3-portal hub with plant obstacles) — strict-backbone applies because the floor between authored anchors has decorative props with collision.

WEST CLIQUE (west_inner + west_n + west_inner_n + west_mid) is densely connected for west-side combat.
